purpose: Preserve optional Piper/Pocket voice functionality from ANTIGA and the application/tests from ATUAL.
observations: Exact local legacy CUDA package versions have been captured, but their remote availability and dependency compatibility still require verification on Windows.
The existing uv.lock is not modified. uv sync in exact mode removes voice packages, so use --inexact for subsequent syncs.
pytest 9.2.0 in ATUAL differs from the uv.lock (pytest 8.4.2). The new installation uses the existing lock and must pass regression tests.
TTS / XTTS and faster-whisper were not listed in either environment, and are not silently installed.
